meta_description:
146K likes, 191 comments - samantharuthprabhuoffl on October 13, 2026: "Women’s wellness has always been important to me. And with @zoycareofficial , we’re making it a conversation that goes beyond just those few days every month. ❤️

Loved bringing Wellness Beyond Your Period to life with some incredible voices. And so special to have @vithya_ramraj with us - a true reminder of what women are capable of.

Here’s to knowing our bodies better, making more conscious choices and never treating our health as an afterthought.".
